theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtsd_good_radius
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (B : ℝ≥0∞), IsFiniteMeasure μ → IsFiniteMeasure μ' → Measurable f → 0 < ρ → μ {x | f x < ρ} ≤ B → ∃ r ∈ Ioo (ρ / 2) ρ, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 / ρ) * B ∧ liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ' {x | r - h < f x ∧ f x < r}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞
